decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal represents an unacceptable development of the site that would provide cramped and unsatisfactory living accommodation for future residents through inadequate private usable garden space, insufficient off street parking and servicing arrangements and inadequate internal provision for people with disabilities, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.3.1 (Access and facilities for people with disabilities), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and associated supplementary planning guidance.

Condition : 2 - 2	Due to the layout at the access point, the long narrow access road and the lack of sufficient forecourt car parking in an area of low public transport accessibility, the proposal provides insufficient arrangements for access by emergency and service vehicles on site contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and associated supplementary planning guidance.
description: Outline application for the erection of 3 houses.
